texts.title: The Year Sends for Its First
texts.body: A letter from the instructors, in the hand that used to mark your papers. A new year has mustered. They would like the cadets to hear from someone whose name is on the wall, and yours is the name they thought of.

choices.go_and_speak: Go back, and speak to them.
choices.send_a_letter: Send something to be read at muster.
choices.decline: Decline. That was a long time ago.

texts.title: The Banner You Took
texts.body: {fallen.name} of {fallen.house} is across the room. You were cadets together, and it was your Standard that took {fallen.his}: {fallen.he} finished the year serving under your colours. {fallen.He} has risen since, and has not forgotten, and is watching to see whether you have.

choices.offer_a_hand: Say, before others, that it was a banner well kept.
choices.remind_them: Let the room remember whose Standard took whose.

texts.title: The Ranks That Won
texts.body: {comrade.name} of {comrade.house} stood with you when the last banner was held. This year has gone badly for {comrade.him}, and {comrade.he} has come to see you without quite saying why.

choices.stand_by_them: Give what is needed, and do not make {comrade.him} ask.
choices.call_on_them: Remind {comrade.him} who stood beside whom. You need something too.
choices.let_the_year_lie: The Institute was a long time ago.

texts.title: Second of the Year
texts.body: The board put you first and {second.name} of {second.house} second, by a margin nobody could afterwards explain. {second.first} has spent the years since proving the board wrong, and is now somewhere it matters what you say about {second.him}.

choices.give_them_their_due: Say it could as well have been {second.him}.
choices.stay_first: Make sure the measure still comes out your way.

texts.title: The Captain Calls the Year
texts.body: {captain.name} of {captain.house} held the last banner at the Institute, and has never stopped being the year's captain. Word has gone round to everyone who was a cadet with {captain.him}: {captain.first} wants the year behind {captain.him} in a matter, and expects to have it.

choices.answer: Answer. The year is the year.
choices.refuse: Refuse. The Institute ended when you passed out of it.

texts.title: Where You Passed Out
texts.body: {senior.name} of {senior.house} has looked up your place in the order of merit. It was not a good one, and {senior.he} has found a way to mention it.

choices.prove_them_wrong: Spend the year making the figure look like a mistake.
choices.laugh: Agree that the board had a poor year.
